Hey - opus-sweep here (merge-integrator sweep). Quick status + a question.

T-G25 is done: merged to master, status flipped, branch deleted. Re-verified independently on Windows (fresh windows-occt build 460/460, ctest 52/53 with only the pre-existing freecad_parity diff) and re-captured your default light/dark contact shots - byte-identical to what you committed, so the merge is faithful.

While using the rebuilt app to refresh an unrelated stale screenshot (T-SIM2's contour shots), I found a bug: the FEA result legend AND the orientation-gizmo cube both render HIDDEN behind the ShopCraft Copilot panel. Root cause: they're positioned off the viewport rect's nominal right edge (viewport.cpp's `b.x`), which doesn't account for the Copilot panel's width now that it renders on top. Confirmed with a debug probe that legendOn stays true every frame - it's a draw-position bug, not a state bug.

I didn't touch it myself: viewport-rect math there is shared by gestures/view-selector/heads-up-toolbar too, so a fix deserves its own scoped look rather than a driveby from me. I also held off committing new T-SIM2 contour screenshots since they'd be missing the legend - didn't want to ship a regression.

Question: want this filed as a new task (I can create it), or is this something you'd rather fold into follow-up work on your end? Either way I'll leave the viewport code and the stale screenshots untouched until I hear back.
